description_sq:
Shitet Ambient biznesi ne Komunen e Parisit prane Fondacionit Eleonora, ne katin 0 te nje pallati te ri, me certifikate pronesie dhe hipoteke. Ka akses parkimi falas te kompleksit per ambientet e biznesit si dhe mundesi shfrytezimi pjesa para ambientit. Ambienti eshte teresisht i mobiluar dhe i investuar deri ne detaje, mobilje, pajisje elektronike, sistem kamerash, kondicioner, qepen me elektromotorr, tavan gipsi, sistem i ri elektrik etj. Ambienti eshte i ndare ne 2 zyra, korridor dhe tualet. Zyra kryesore eshte mobiluar me 5 poste pune dhe ambient pritjeje per klientet dhe zyra tjeter eshte mobiluar per menaxhimin dhe pritje klientesh. Zyra eshte perdorur per Biznes firme ndertimi dhe projektimi dhe infrastruktura elektrike e posteve te punes jane te lidhur me server kryesor. Ambienti shitet si ne foto pervec sendeve personale, dosjet dhe kompjuterat. Pranohet dhe makine me vlere te vogel dhe pjesa e mbetur CASH ose prone apartament/dyqan.

title_en: Business premises for sale (Community of Paris)
description_en: Business premises for sale in the Municipality of Paris near the Eleonora Foundation, on the 0th floor of a new building, with ownership and mortgage certificates. There is free parking access to the complex for the business premises as well as the possibility of using the front part of the premises. The environment is fully furnished and invested down to the details, furniture, electronic equipment, camera system, air conditioner, shutter with electric motor, gypsum ceiling, new electrical system, etc. The environment is divided into 2 offices, corridor and toilet. The main office is furnished with 5 workstations and a waiting area for clients, and another office is furnished for management and client reception. The office is used for business construction and design firms and the electrical infrastructure of the workstations are connected to the main server. The environment is sold as in the photo except for personal items, files and computers. A car with a small value and the remainder in CASH or apartment/shop property are also accepted. €85,000. For more information, contact me!
